_comment: Claude Desktop (Settings > Developer > Edit Config). Use EXACTLY ONE of `deltr` (mcp-remote to the running `python main.py` on :8000, recommended: the dashboard shows what Claude does) or `deltr-stdio-alternative` (runs the whole engine inside Claude Desktop; do not run it alongside a separate `python main.py`). `binance-shim` is the optional local Binance-shaped shim (testnet only, keyless market tools). Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/Deltr with your clone path (e.g. the output of `pwd`).
